recent_posts.title: AI News for Devs #22: Agentic Coding, AWS x OpenAI, and AI That Builds Its Own Data
recent_posts.summary: A developer-focused AI news roundup covering: Google's shift to agentic coding workflows (75% of new code AI-generated, 6x faster migrations), Meta's business AI assistant reaching 10M conversations/week, OpenAI models (GPT-5.5, GPT-4.5, Codex) now available on Amazon Bedrock, Meta AI's Autodata method for synthetic dataset generation using multi-agent pipelines, and Google's new agents-cli tool for building and deploying agents via the Agent Development Kit.

recent_posts.title: AI News #21: GPT-5.5, Images 2.0 & Real Production Agents
recent_posts.summary: A developer-focused AI news roundup covering three major announcements: OpenAI's GPT-5.5 release with a 1M-token context window at doubled pricing but improved benchmark performance; ChatGPT Images 2.0 repositioning image generation as a developer workflow platform available via API; and Google's AI Agent Clinic lessons on refactoring monolithic agents for production, recommending structured outputs, dynamic RAG, and observability. Also includes a short tutorial on running Hermes Agent locally with Ollama.

recent_posts.title: GitHub Copilot Agents Explained
recent_posts.summary: A practical guide to GitHub Copilot Agents covering agent architecture (LLM + tools + context), the differences between VS Code, CLI, and Cloud agents, and how to build custom agents using `.agent.md` files. Aimed at developers looking to integrate AI workflows into their development process.

recent_posts.title: AI News for Developers #19: The Agentic Stack Is Real (Gemma 4, Bonsai 8B, Cursor 3)
recent_posts.summary: A developer-focused AI news roundup covering major releases this week. Google launched Gemma 4 open models with multimodal support and long context windows up to 256K tokens. Microsoft released MAI-Transcribe-1, MAI-Voice-1, and MAI-Image-2 for productivity use cases. PrismML introduced Bonsai 8B, a 1-bit 1.15 GB model that is 14× smaller and 8× faster than full-precision equivalents. Alibaba previewed Qwen 3.6 Plus with a 1-million-token context window suited for agentic coding. Cursor 3 was announced as an agent-centric IDE with multi-agent support, a built-in browser, and a plugin marketplace. A GitHub Copilot CLI guide covering slash commands is also highlighted.

recent_posts.title: AI News for Developers #17: On-Device AI, Gemini Embedding 2, Anthropic Institute & Agent Security
recent_posts.summary: A developer-focused AI news roundup covering four key updates: Anthropic's new institute for AI societal research led by Jack Clark; Stanford's OpenJarvis, an open-source on-device personal AI agent framework; Google's Gemini Embedding 2, a natively multimodal embedding model supporting text, images, video, and audio in a single shared space; and OpenAI's guidance on designing AI agents to resist prompt injection attacks, framing it as a product design challenge rather than a model-level problem.

recent_posts.title: Build Production Apps Without Coding in 2026
recent_posts.summary: Softr is a full-stack no-code platform that combines AI-powered interface generation with real data connectivity, user permissions, and workflow automation. Unlike front-end-only builders, it provides integrated database support (17+ sources including Google Sheets, Airtable, SQL), native workflows for automations, and a "Vibe Coding" block that generates custom UI components from natural language descriptions. The platform enables deployment of production-ready internal tools, dashboards, and client portals without writing code, while maintaining security controls and integration capabilities with tools like Zapier and Make.

recent_posts.title: Avoid Potential Breaches: Secure OpenClaw Now
recent_posts.summary: A quick tutorial demonstrates how to secure OpenClaw AI agents in approximately 5 minutes. The guide covers essential security measures including gateway authentication, sandboxing, tool restrictions, and secrets management for local AI agent deployments.

recent_posts.title: OpenClaw Setup: From Terminal to Telegram Bot in 8 Minutes
recent_posts.summary: OpenClaw (Clawdbot) is a locally-run AI agent that connects to Telegram, allowing you to control your computer remotely through chat messages. The setup involves terminal installation, configuring gateway permissions, and pairing with the Telegram Bot API. Running locally enables the agent to interact directly with your machine—opening browsers, executing scripts, and accessing files—all triggered from your phone.

recent_posts.title: AI News for Developers #11: Prism Launches, Kimi K2.5 Surprises, LiteRT Goes On-Device
recent_posts.summary: This week's AI updates include OpenAI's Prism workspace for scientific writing with GPT-5.2, Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5 open-weights model with multimodal capabilities and agent swarm systems, Mercedes-Benz's L4-ready autonomous S-Class built on NVIDIA DRIVE AV platform, Google's LiteRT framework for on-device AI with improved performance and cross-platform support, and a guide for running Claude Code locally using Ollama with open-source models.

recent_posts.title: Make Codex Smarter with SKILLS.md
recent_posts.summary: Codex Skills allow developers to package workflows into reusable, discoverable instructions that OpenAI Codex loads on demand, eliminating the need to repeat prompts and improving efficiency when working with the AI coding assistant.
